title: The US dollar on the first two trading days of a month
system: Research only (US dollar basket, seven pairs)
headline: FAIL: the dollar basket over the first two days of a month, short USD (learned 2005-14): out of sample −0.030R a month (n 143, t −0.74), placebo 16 of 40.

data.src: OANDA mid daily candles (UTC days, close 00:00 UTC = 19:00 / 20:00 New York), council-data research/daily/<key>.json (git show), weekend folded into Monday (council/fills.mjs foldWeekend); spx500 the same way for the reported split

rule.hold: close of the last basket day of the month to the close of the 2nd basket day of the next
rule.sideNote: the sign of the in-sample mean gross long-USD basket %, learned in sample and applied out of sample

costs.note: one raw-spread round trip per leg; 2x doubles spread, commission and the rate markup; 0 = no spread, no commission (financing kept)

financing.note: today's broker swaps for EUR, GBP, AUD, CAD, CHF on every year; NZD and JPY from the fx-carry rate table less the markup; three nights on a Wednesday candle

equitySplit.note: Sign of the SPX500 CFD return over the month that ends at E; each group learns its own side in sample
